        "All 720 owned diff lines across ten paths were read, including complete 166-line Rust hierarchy operation, Graph fake-server handlers, both protocol test refactors, OAuth expected values and Cargo changes. The only new crate is fxhash for the folder-ID map; manifest reorder is separate mechanical context.",
        "Original bridge startup converts empty sync state to None, constructs a client, detaches an async task and returns Ok. Completion is later: DoOperation awaits the operation, then the safe listener forwards OnSuccess; tests await that listener's promise. A successful bridge return is not completed folder persistence or a rollback guarantee.",
        "With no token, the original operation first obtains a delta response, then serially maps distinguished folders with a root-first assertion and notifies the root before processing delta entries. With a token it uses GetDelta and skips that initial map. Missing IDs/names/parents become errors; absent distinguished folders remain an explicit TODO.",
        "Original folder processing attempts on_folder_updated and falls back to on_folder_created after any error. It leaves removed objects as a FIXME. These later changes are not credited to this first implementation.",
        "The original fake server provides well-known folders, a paged /me/mailFolders/delta() response with skip tokens and a fixed terminal token, plus individual folder lookup. It filters the root from delta values. A fixed fake token and configured page size do not prove real incremental deletion or token semantics.",
        "Shared helpers run initial and multi-page cases for both EWS and Graph, directly compare created folder IDs and require token presence after listener completion. The listener deliberately rejects unknown updates to drive original create fallback. Classless-folder and busy-retry cases remain EWS-only; no Graph retry or deletion test is inferred. Setup cleanup responsibility moves to the actual shared helper, which registers shutdown/stop cleanup.",
        "The changed OAuth graph expectation lacks an assertion message; hierarchy/root/order assertions have nonempty expected-behavior messages.
